title: About ToolsBuilt: Who Builds It and How It Works
description: Who builds ToolsBuilt, how the calculators and guides are made and checked, where AI helps, and how your numbers stay private in your own browser.
subtitle: Free calculators and tools that run in your browser, built and checked by one developer.

what-it-is.heading: What ToolsBuilt is
what-it-is.p1: ToolsBuilt is a set of 50 free calculators and web tools: loan EMI, salary tax, percentages, grades, GPA, dates, text and passwords, among others. Every tool is available in 9 languages, needs no account and shows no ads.
what-it-is.p2: Each calculator does its work inside your browser. The numbers you type are not sent to a ToolsBuilt server, and the page explains the formula it uses, with worked examples, so you can check the answer yourself.

author.heading: Who builds it
author.p1: I'm Abu Umair. In my day-to-day work I build business systems in Odoo Studio, setting up the sales, stock, accounting and other processes a company runs on. ToolsBuilt is my own project, built and maintained by me alone.
author.p2: I started it because the calculators I needed were often buried under ads and sign-up forms, or did not show how they reached their answer. I wanted tools that load fast on a phone, show their working and keep the numbers private.

how-made.heading: How the tools and guides are made
how-made.p1: I build ToolsBuilt with the help of AI assistants. AI helps me write code, draft the guides and translate the pages. I decide what gets built and published, and nothing goes live until it has passed the checks below.
how-made.li1: Calculations are tested. Each calculator's maths lives in its own file, covered by more than 1,000 automated checks that must pass before any change is published.
how-made.li2: Numbers in the guides come from the tools. Every worked example and chart is recalculated with the same code the calculator uses, so the guide and the tool always agree.
how-made.li3: Translations are checked by script. The 8 translations are made with AI. Scripts check that every number, link and example matches the English page. Not every page has been read by a native speaker yet.
how-made.p2: When I find a mistake, I fix it and say so. While writing the grade guide, I found that the grade calculator rounded too early and showed 93.99% where the answer is 94%. It was fixed the same day.

promises.heading: What you can expect
promises.li1: Privacy: calculations run on your device. Some tools remember your last inputs in your own browser, and the Reset button clears them.
promises.li2: No ads, no account: every tool is free to use, as often as you like.
promises.li3: Analytics only with your consent: Google Analytics loads only if you accept it in the cookie banner. The Privacy Policy has the details.
promises.li4: Open source: the code is public on GitHub, so anyone can see how a result is worked out.

get-in-touch.heading: Found a mistake or need a tool?
get-in-touch.p1: If a result looks wrong, a sentence reads badly in your language, or you need a calculator that is not here, please write to me through the Contact page. For a wrong result, include the numbers you entered so I can reproduce it.
